title: PR #50 report A: hypothetical death with both dates -- which death benefits may apply and the next steps

turns.user: Hypothetical test: Adrian died in a car accident in Japan. The accident happened on 3 October 2026 and he died on 5 October 2026. Based on my uploaded documents, explain which death benefits may apply and what I should do next.
turns.visible:
Adrian’s certificate lists Group Term Life of S$1,000,000 as of 6 October 2022; this is the amount on that date, not confirmation of cover on the hypothetical death date.
The Public Officers Group Personal Accident - Summary of Benefits (page 9) prints Accidental Death: 100% of the Sum Insured.
Adrian’s certificate lists Group Personal Accident of S$600,000 as of 6 October 2022; the uploaded documents do not establish that this amount remained in force on 5 October 2026.
The group summary lists a separate Death due to Accident allowance of S$3,000 only for insured persons enrolled for that optional cover, and Adrian’s enrollment is not established in the uploaded documents.
The group policy wording says its Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit applies when an insured person dies as a result of an Accident, on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in the prescribed form; Adrian’s enrollment and the allowance amount are not established in the uploaded documents.
The travel wording provides an Accidental Death benefit only for a journey shown in a schedule issued to the insured person, and if death occurs within 90 days of an accident during that journey; Adrian’s personal travel schedule and confirmed cover are not in the uploaded documents.
The uploaded documents do not establish whether Adrian’s group cover was in force on 5 October 2026 or whether the optional death allowance applied.

The uploaded documents do not establish whether Adrian’s group cover was in force on 5 October 2026 or whether the optional death allowance applied.
